messages:
maria.s: seeing controller-manager leader flips and apiserver 503s in eu-central over the last 15m. GPUs are attaching/detaching wildly after a scheduled scale job. anyone watching that pool?

james: yep, I see a huge attach/detach churn from dedicated-gpu-pool-2 — ~1.2k attach/detach events in 10m. logs are full of timeouts.

arun: controller-manager pods in kube-system are reporting a lot of watch reconnects and occasional OOMKilled restarts. sample log: `E0301 12:45:10.123456 1 reflector.go:205] pkg/mod/k8s.io/client-go@...: failed to watch *v1.Node: read tcp 10.0.0.5:6443->10.1.2.3:52344: read: connection reset by peer`

lucy: also seeing NAT ephemeral port counters on nat-euc1 near 64k. think we're hitting SNAT port exhaustion from all the short-lived control-plane connections :thinking_face: 

maria.s: opening incident and tagging oncall. immediate ask: can we slow down the attach rate from the provisioner and restart controller-manager pods sequentially?

sre-bot: Incident 2026-03-eu-nat created by maria.s - severity: P1 - https://inc/2026-03-eu-nat

james: ran quick checks: `kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/controller-manager -c manager | tail -n 200` shows repeated auth/timeout errors and reconnect attempts. also ran `netstat -anp | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l` -> 31200 ESTABLISHED connections on ctrl-plane nodes.

arun: on ctrl-plane srx-ctrl-1 `ss -s` shows a huge number of sockets in TIME_WAIT/ESTABLISHED. snippet: ```TIME_WAIT: 29000
ESTAB: 32000```

lucy: apiserver metrics: `apiserver_request_total{code="503"}` spike aligns with the attach burst. etcd leader shows proposal backlog increase in metrics. suspect head-of-line blocking from churned keeps.

maria.s: mitigation plan: 1) throttle attach rate at provisioner (apply temporary rateLimit 30/s) 2) sequential restart controller-manager replicas with 30s delay 3) request +1 floating IP for nat-euc1 to expand SNAT pool 4) keep canaries for apiserver/etcd healthy. executing now.

james: patched provisioner configmap -> added `rateLimit: 30` and applied. command: `kubectl patch cm provisioner-config -n infra -p \"{\"data\":{\"rateLimit\":\"30\"}}\"`

deploy-bot: deploy completed: configmap/provisioner-config updated by james (rev 4821)

arun: restarted controller-manager on sre-ctrl-2 then srx-ctrl-3 sequentially. leader election stabilized after second restart, watch reconnects dropped ~95%.

lucy: added ephemeral alerts: `nat_port_exhaustion` and `controller_manager_watch_reconnects` with 5m window. dashboards updated to show attach/detach rate for dedicated-gpu-pool-2.

maria.s: keeping incident open for monitoring for 2 hours. cost note: burst provisioning created ~\$6k of transient GPU attach charges this morning — filing billing ticket.

james: filed BILL-9876 referencing incident 2026-03-eu-nat.

maria.s: follow-ups: short-term done. long-term actions: client-side attach batching, exponential backoff in provisioner, and add automatic SNAT pool autoscaling for eu region. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :heart:

lucy: adding action items to infra backlog and scheduling a postmortem next week.
